name: espfleet
description: Lightweight fleet agent for ESP32 boards: heartbeat to a central hub, report the exact git commit you are running, expose a JSON status endpoint, advertise over mDNS and accept HTTP OTA updates. Works on esp32, esp32s2, esp32s3, esp32c3, esp32c5 and esp32c6, under both the Arduino and ESP-IDF frameworks.
keywords: esp32, ota, fleet, mdns, gogs, management
